rows.text: For reasons unknown, the star of Bodlan fell into an eternal "hunger," ceaselessly devouring the celestial bodies around it. To prevent their home planet from being consumed, Bodlanians constructed massive mass drivers on the surface and took to feeding their star through offerings: soil, houses, even abstract concepts... The disagreements this sparked triggered one downturn, two civil wars, and three major falling-outs. It wasn't until Kankandi, a researcher from the Baking School, arrived to survey the segmentum and traded a single cake for three months of sunlight that Bodlanians finally realized they'd been going about it all wrong — "mass" was never the point. "Flavor" was.
